reviews.text:
I found Patikoy after moving to the neighborhood a year ago and am still amazed by every grooming service I've gotten. Friendly, helpful staff with a huge love for dogs. It made me come back even though as a wheelchair user, the building is not accessible beyond the front door. I think this could be solved with a ramp to replace the step down but also understand that can be costly. The staff are more than willing to help me out so it does make the experience better than a lot of inaccessible places in Vancouver I've dealt with.

I have a 11 yr-old medium coat german shepherd and have been getting her groomed for years at many different places. To say this place shocked me with its work is an understatement. I've never seen such clean work, that required no extra brushing after or shedding clean up. She looks beautiful every time and the cut is functional without undermining her coat's integrity. They really bring out her natural beauty and give her so much love all the while. I love the kind staff and my dog has never been happier after a grooming session as she has with Patikoy. I also have used their daycare services regularly to help socialize my dog in a supervised environment and find she looks forward to seeing Seda and the team even just out on walks. I am so glad I found Patikoy and love whatever they use as the shampoo scent. My dog smells so nice for weeks after! (That's not an easy feat with an old dog. LOL) I would definitely recommend anyone with a GSD to go to Seda! I've seen other breeds of dogs that have left after a new cut and I'm always blown away. Amazing work.

After many traumatic visits to the vet for nail trims and ear cleaning,  we found Patikoy!!  Our dog's nails have never looked so good, nice and short! And, she comes home happy, shiny, and smelling fantastic!  Highly rate this place for grooming,  especially if you have a nervous dog ❤️👍
Did a wonderful job!

Ask detailed questions if you are going to Patikoy for the first time.  Our shihtzu, is 2 yrs old and 15 pounds.  According to the price chart, looks like the cost of full grooming is $80.  We take him in and the woman quotes price of $110.00 without any explanations.  To be fair my son probably should have asked why there is an extra $30.00 being charged.  I am the grandparent of this dog and had offered to pay for his grooming fees as his birthday present...which I was OK to pay approx $110.  However by the time my son went to pick up doggy, the final price was $152.00 and the woman said this is due to matted fur and poor behaviour.  There were no photos shown as evidence of matted fur, there was no videoclip or phone call to discuss/renegotiate about poor behaviour charges.  The fee ended up being almost twice as much as the expected $80.00.  No complaints about the haircut.  Their fee structure and lack of communication means you can be on the hook for a much bigger bill than you expected.
Great first experience today with our anxious Irish setter Jupiter. She entered a little scruffy and came out looking regal :)
Super friendly and kind.  Snowy looks sooo beautiful after her grooming 🎀 …
Patikoy does a truly excellent job grooming my chihuahua, she always comes out looking her best self! Thank you!!

My dogs have flourished in every way since spending time with Seda. My previously anxious 3 year old is now confident and happy. My puppy has learned patience and how to use or not use his inside voice! This isn’t just a daycare or a grooming, it is a co-parent! I have to add that every person here shares the warmth and care that Seda has. You will be so happy you shared this wonderful place with your furry family!
Great first experience! Seda was amazing  with my two puppies! She offered great advice to help train as well, thank you:)

My sister recommended Patikoy and now we travel from Steveston to Vancouver for all of our Bernadoodle's grooming needs. Seda goes above and beyond and takes such great care of our dog who is a little nervous. She also has amazing availability and a flexible schedule, which is hard to find we could not recommend Seda more!
My toy poodle came back so clean and cute. She was very nice and definitely knows what she is doing! She makes my dog beautiful! Will come back and thank you :)

I’ve tried several grooming places before, but Patiköy truly stands out. From the moment we walked in, I felt that my dog was in safe and caring hands. The team is not only highly professional but also genuinely passionate about animals — and you can clearly see that in the way they treat them.

My dog can sometimes be a bit difficult, but they handled him with patience, kindness, and confidence. The result honestly exceeded my expectations. His coat looks incredibly healthy, soft, and perfectly styled — I couldn’t stop smiling when I saw him.

It’s rare to find a place where you feel both trust and satisfaction at this level. Patiköy has definitely earned my loyalty. I highly recommend them to anyone who truly cares about their pet’s well-being and appearance.

I can confidently say this is one of the best dog groomers in Vancouver. I took my 9-month-old Pomeranian for a scissor cut, and they did an amazing job. There wasn’t a single mat left. His coat was perfectly clean, the fur between his paw pads was trimmed, and his nails were cut as well. Every part of his grooming was done with great care and attention to detail. The environment was very clean, and everything was disinfected immediately after the grooming session. You can bring your pet here with complete peace of mind. I also add before after photos.

I first took my dog Theo to Patiköy for a nail trim, and that’s when I discovered they also offer daycare for dogs of all sizes—exactly the exposure / socialization I was looking for while Theo was still a puppy.  He enjoys his time at Patiköy - always excited for his playdates and grooming visits.

Seda and her team have created a fun, spacious, and safe environment.  As a first-time dog mom, I’ve also really appreciated Seda’s guidance—she’s been incredibly helpful!  Now at 17 months old, Theo is happy, healthy, and thriving - Patiköy has played a big role in that!
I took my very large, very spirited, standard poodle in for a full groom for the first time this week. Seda did a great job! We will definitely be coming back.

Our Australian Shepherd Jasper became very anxious lately and I wasn’t sure he could be groomed, however, Seda did a fantastic job of beautifully grooming him and doing his nails too. We are very happy and thankful!!
I love taking my dog Sunny to Patikoy. It’s mostly for nails & to blow her coat out. They always have time for me & you won’t find a friendlier or more caring staff.

We can't recommend Patikoy enough. We have put our dog GG in at least once a week since she was a puppy and she loves it. She pulls us from home all the way there with excitement. It's been brilliant for socialising her with other dogs. We also put her on the hike each time she is in and the team at Patikoy have really helped with her offleash recall. If you live in the area I would 100% recommend this day care.

I decided to try a new grooming place because they offered online bookings, and I’m so glad I did! Seda was incredibly responsive and easy to communicate with. When I brought my 6-year-old Labradoodle in for his first visit, she spent about 20 minutes getting to know him before starting. She also gave me excellent advice on how to desensitize him for home grooming and nail clipping.
Seda helped me create a grooming schedule for his overgrown nails—something no other groomer had ever mentioned before. She is a true professional who clearly loves animals and takes her work seriously. When I picked up my dog, his full groom was perfect, and his paws and nails were beautifully manicured. I cannot recommend Patikoy enough!
Seda does an excellent groom for our Cavapoo and her knowledge about dogs is exceptional - I highly recommend Patikoy !
Our poodle was treated with love and care. Not nervous in any way. Clipping and grooming were perfect.
Not recommended for cats. She cannot handle nervous cats and charges extra for behavior issues or what not. She is not a cat groomer.
I’ve been taking my puppy here for months and he always leaves happy and looking amazing! I know he’s getting the best care. ❤️

Seda did an amazing job on my aussie's grooming!! She did a full trim and deshed and my pup is silky smooth. I went to someone else previously who I know now clearly did not know how to groom aussies. I highly recommend Patikoy and I will be going back. Thank you!

We just took our two-year old cats for their first grooming ever. Seda was so lovely and caring with our boys! They came home so soft, and it was obvious that our big fluffy fella felt so good after deshedding and dematting. I appreciate the sensitivity of offering to schedule their appointments for a time when there were no dogs there for daycare. We will certainly be scheduling with Patikoy again. Thank you, Seda!
Very good work, loved everything about our dog’s grooming service. Full groom done with care and great attention to detail.  We will definitely become regulars.

My more than energetic golden lab (Parker) needed his nails trimmed. I did not have an appointment and just walked-in. The person on staff was prompt and took Parker right away, she was very friendly with him and safely clipped his nails.

He was very happy when she gave him treats at the end! Thank you.
Patikoy has been amazing for our pup Grace! Professional, flexible and quality care.
Great service, very talented groomer.  The dogs love going.
I have a small havanese shitszu that looks and acts like an angry muppet. The groomers at Patikoy transform this little beast into a cute, and manageable, pup.

We started bringing our puppy to Patikoy about a year ago and she absolutely loves it! It has very quickly become our dog's home away from home.

Great facility (super nice and clean) and great people, highly recommended.
I have used their daycare service and grooming service and I have been extremely happy with both!  My dog Bamboo loves to visit and I like how clean the facility is!

Patikoy has been a fantastic daycare for my 1 year old pup. She loves going and comes home very tired at the end of the day. The staff is attentive and caring to all the dogs. She also gets her nails trimmed here which has been very helpful as well. Two of my friends have started bringing their dogs here too and I would recommend it to anyone else!

I wish I could give 10 stars — for me, this place is well above 5! Patiköy in W Broadway, Kitsilano, is truly a unique and spacious daycare. The moment you walk in, you can tell how clean it is just by the smell. Dogs are never overcrowded, and they have a large open area to play. They go for two daily walks, and for an extra $10, they even take the dogs on a hike to Pacific Park. I had sent my dog to a few other places before, but he would often come home smelling like urine or with greasy paws. Since he started going to Patiköy, these issues have completely stopped. My dog also has a bad habit of sometimes eating feces, and they are very diligent about preventing it. They also have an excellent grooming service.
Thank you Seda and her team! You are the best guys!! ❤️

We brought our Persian cat to Patikoy for a lion cut and grooming after we had had a bad experience at our regular grooming salon. Patikoy will be our new regular spot! She did such a great job with Gloria's (our cat) grooming, and we were amazed at how happy and comfortable Gloria seemed when we came to pick her up. Seda, the owner I believe, made sure to not have other dogs there when she knew she'd be doing a cat grooming, something that definitely helped our cat feel more at ease and less anxious. She was so kind towards our cat and you can tell she really cares about animals. Plus, Gloria's haircut and groom were done so well and she smelled amazing :) Thank you!!
Seda was amazing with my dog—he’s usually anxious with grooming, but this time he came out happy and looking exactly how I wanted. So grateful to have found her!

I was planning to go to this place for daycare service but they difinitely wasted my time，i set up the account and added all info as the website requested，then they contacted me saying all dogs have to have rabbies vaccine which is good，i waited for one week for my golden retriever puppy to get the rabbies vaccine as hes only almost 4 months that is the only last shot he needs，then requested vet the vaccine certificate as Ptikoy asked. then after all these they told me“ oh just btw we wont accept any dog at or over 6 months that not get fixed”，i was like “？？？” you didnt bother to tell me this before all those requests？i put my puppy‘s age and neuter status when i set up the account（golden retriever cant get fixed under 1 year old），the the owner texted back“well puppy needs to socialize anyway and no other daycare will accept dog withou neuter”，my puppy goes to puppy school everyweek and gets other socialization as well，plus i know a friend takes her golden puppy who is months older than mine so obviously not all daycares have same rule，just the fact they would want you to take puppy only stay there for 2 months and does not care what happens after that proves its a business that pure profit driven，i would not consider going even after my puppy gets neuter in future.

Our pup, Trio goes to Patiköy on occasion for daycare and we are always happy with the service. Yesterday, she was groomed there for the first time and Seda and her team did an excellent job. Trio needed extra care and attention as it was a more challenging and she absolutely received that. Seda communicated very well to ask about sensitivities, what we wanted and let me know what she felt was best. She also shared how Trio was doing during the day, which I really appreciated. Trio looked so great after her groom! Adorable! We will definitely use Patiköy for that service again.
We brought our Irish setter in for the first time today for daycare and grooming. They did such a great job, she looked adorable when she came home. Definitely returning :)
This was our first time here with our Pom and it was such a lovely experience! Definitely our new groomers.  The owner is so sweet. Thank you so much

As a first time dog owner with a puppy who is very anxious and timid, I was nervous leaving her. However, Patikoy has helped my dog's confidence so much and Seda + the staff are so welcoming and attentive. My dog used to freak out and get so scared getting her nails clipped at other groomer's but Seda is magically able to do it without making her stressed!

Patiköy was recommended to us by another local doggy daycare because our young active pup needed a bit more stimulation, outdoor time, and larger dogs to play with (previous daycare was small dogs only). We have nothing but positive things to say about this daycare. The environment always seems very calm and controlled, and never over crowded (10 or so dogs in a large space). Our dog can have a hard time settling when a lot is going on, but I've found him curled up on the couch several times during pick up, and he is always excited to be dropped off and greeted by Seda or any of the wonderful staff. If you are looking for daycare 2-3 times a week, there's a great package that includes complimentary 1-1.5 hr hikes in Pacific Spirit. We were also very happy with the grooming services, which include free daycare for that day, and Seda has also provided some super helpful training tips! Would highly recommend Patiköy to any dog owner!

It’s hard to find a good dog daycare in the city, we’ve been through many. This one is fantastic. Good staff to dogs ratio. Very professional. They walk them often.
And they are excellent about maintaining supervision of the environment and the dogs interactions… breaking them into separate “zones” sometimes. It’s very good. Highly recommend.
This is a great place to go to! They did a fantastic job

My dogs love it there! Practcally drag me in anytime we are in the neighborhood. My younger dog hated being groomed at all previous places but is very happy going to Patikoy. And my older dog is 13 and frail. They pamper him quite lovingly. I feel super comfortable with leaving my fur babies at Patikoy
Another action packed day with Seda and the gang! The girls love going to doggy care where they are well taken care of and have fun! No more bored dogs, highly recommend!
The only place I’d take my nervous Dachshund for all of his grooming needs.

The young woman at Patikoy is a miracle worker!  My wonderful little Siberian cat with very long fur hates being brushed by me and consequently is prone to knots.  Patikoy is able to groom her completely and after her beauty treatment, she doesn't shed for months!  I highly recommend Patikoy.

My dog Roxy loves this place! She used to be hesitant when we dropped her off at doggy day care, but at Patikoy she is excited to go there whenever we bring her. I will also say that Seda does an amazing job with the grooming - this husky has never come back from grooming so clean before! Highly recommend!

I started taking Hutch to Patikoy 2 months ago and I couldn't be happier with the experience! The staff is incredibly friendly and attentive, making sure each dog feels loved and safe. My dog came home tired and happy after a day filled with fun activities and socialization. I highly recommend Patikoy to any dog owner looking for a trustworthy and caring daycare!

Absolutely LOVE this place and especially Seda! The groomer we used to go to (at a different groomers), moved out of the country and I was worried we'd never find a replacement. WRONG!!! Our 3 yr old corgi has zero concerns when she comes in and they do a wonderful job. She always comes out with her little "loaf" butt and way less fur then when she went in (they excel in deshedding)! Thank you taking care of her as if she were your own ❤️🐶
Seda has great attention to detail for grooming. She is our favorite for a great experience.

I've been taking my pup to Patikoy 1-2x a week. They are fantastic with the dogs and he loves it there. He has so much fun and plays so hard each day at Patikoy that he comes home, instantly passes out, then sleeps most of the next day too! …
Seda is amazing! She’s so good with all of the dogs and offers full service grooming as well. Highly recommend.
I take my dog (rescue) here for daycare and grooming and she LOVES it! The staff are so kind and extremely knowledgeable. Wouldn’t go anywhere else, highly recommend!

Maybe this place is good as a daycare but I wanted to write a review to warn people against coming here for grooming. I took my dog here to get his nails clipped and for the first time ever *I* had to hold my dog while he was getting his …
